description: Look up a Chinese zodiac year: its animal, stem element, yin-yang, and the Lunar New Year dates it starts and ends on. Use it to explain why a January or February birthday belongs to the previous animal. Needs no personal data.

year.description: The zodiac year, the one that starts at that calendar year's Lunar New Year.

name: get_chinese_zodiac_year
title: Chinese zodiac year
